name: dynactin subunit 1

function.text: DCTN1 encodes dynactin subunit 1. Annotated molecular activities include microtubule binding and tubulin binding. It participates in centriole-centriole cohesion and cholesterol homeostasis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Perry syndrome (autosomal dominant); amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-positive histiocytosis. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
